text:
Vanessa Ortiz: staging rollout checklist for enabling the new provision-to-ready pipeline (feature-flagged). want this thread to be the single source of truth for the run today. who’s on point per step below?

Vanessa Ortiz: Proposed window: 11:30–13:00 PT. Target pool: `ded-stg-internal-a` (us-west-2, L40S).

Vanessa Ortiz: Owners (tentative):
- Orchestration/flag + control plane: @Gabe Wilson
- Infra/IaC apply: @Harish Reddy
- Networking readiness checks: @Victor Alvarez
- Cluster topology sanity: @Nina Petrova
- Autoscaling/guardrails: @Keiko Yamamoto
- SRE safety + paging thresholds: @Rafael Mendes / @Aisha Bello
- Rollback coordination: @Connor O'Brien
- Runbook updates / notes: @Kira Thompson

Vanessa Ortiz: Checklist v0 (please reply with edits):
1) Preflight: confirm we’re on the expected versions
   - redwood main deployed to staging control plane (includes pause/resume + stage rerun)
   - terraform module version pinned (redwood-terraform PR 913/914)
   - helm chart version pinned for runtime bootstrap (redwood-helm-charts PR 511)
   - golden image version approved for staging

2) Enable staging-only feature flag
   - set `provision_to_ready_pipeline_v2=true` in staging
   - verify flag read on provisioner service

3) Dry run the provisioning request (no infra mutations)
   `rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --dry-run`
   - confirm resolved plan shows stages: Requested→Provisioning→Imaging→Bootstrapping→Validating

4) Run actual provisioning
   `rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --reason "staging pilot"`

5) Watch state machine + stage timers
   - dashboard: Time-to-ready (staging) + per-stage durations
   - logs: provisioning correlation ID

6) Validation gates (must pass before Ready)
   - GPU health: ECC, clocks, driver
   - networking: DNS, egress, TLS
   - runtime smoke test
   - perf-canary readiness suite

7) Ready handoff
   - ensure control plane marks pool Ready
   - ensure routing does NOT advertise until Ready

8) Post-checks
   - drift detection job reports clean
   - Slack bot posts stage summary (no dupes)

9) Rollback triggers (any one):
   - stage stuck > stage budget
   - repeated failures w/ same error (>=3)
   - validation failures that look systemic (DNS/TLS, image mismatch)

Rollback plan:
   a) `rwctl provision pause --env=staging --run-id <id>`
   b) set flag `provision_to_ready_pipeline_v2=false`
   c) revert to manual/bootstrap path OR tear down staging pool if needed

Harish Reddy: I can take IaC apply + tear down if we need it. For step 1: terraform is pinned in staging to `redwood-terraform@v0.42.3` right now. Need confirmation that includes 913/914 in that tag.

Gabe Wilson: I’m on orchestration/flag. The staging deploy for control plane is already on `2025.02.26-rc3` which includes PR-48244 (staging-only flag) + PR-48246 (pause/resume). Will double-check provisioner service reads the flag without restart.

Victor Alvarez: I’ll own networking readiness. I want explicit commands in the checklist so it’s not “tribal knowledge”. Suggest adding:
- `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -o wide` (coredns healthy)
- `nslookup api.redwood.internal` from a node/pod
- `curl -sv https://controlplane.stg.redwood.ai/healthz` from node
- verify VPC endpoints (if used) + NAT egress

Nina Petrova: On topology sanity. For Bootstrapping stage, please ensure node labels/taints are set correctly before runtime install:
- `kubectl get nodes --show-labels | grep gpu`
- expected taints: `nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule`
- expected labels: `nodepool=ded-stg-internal-a`, `sku=l40s`

Keiko Yamamoto: I can do autoscaling guardrails review. For staging we should set conservative values:
- min=0 max=4 for the pool
- disable burst until we see stable readiness
- make sure the orchestration wrapper isn’t fighting cluster autoscaler

Rafael Mendes: I’ll watch for safety/paging. Reminder: in staging, no paging, but we should still validate alert thresholds are sane and not noisy. Please link the dashboard panel that shows “stuck in stage”.

Aisha Bello: +1. Also we should capture a single “golden run” correlation ID and paste it here for the retro. For stage budgets, I’m using:
- Provisioning (Terraform): 25m
- Imaging: 35m
- Bootstrapping: 20m
- Validating: 15m
Total target <= 95m

Connor O'Brien: I’ll coordinate rollback. One request: add a clear “stop the bleeding” command to the top if we see weirdness:
`rwctl provision pause --env=staging --run-id <id> --reason "rollout safety"`
(and who has perms). In staging, I think Gabe/Vanessa/Harish have it.

Kira Thompson: I’ll take notes + update runbook after. Please drop the exact commands + expected outputs (even rough). Especially for the Ready handoff check.

Vanessa Ortiz: edits incorporated. Adding explicit links (internal):
- staging time-to-ready dashboard: https://grafana.stg.redwood.ai/d/ded-ttready
- provisioning runs UI: https://console.stg.redwood.ai/fleet/provisioning
- runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/infra-provisioning-runbook

Gabe Wilson: Step 2 command (flag):
`rwctl admin flags set --env=staging provision_to_ready_pipeline_v2 true`
Verify:
`rwctl admin flags get --env=staging | grep provision_to_ready`

DeployBot: deploy started: `control-plane-staging` (requested by Gabe Wilson) [build: 2025.02.26-rc3] (ETA ~6m)

Harish Reddy: For step 3 dry-run, can we also dump the resolved terraform vars? We’ve had “wrong region default” issues before.

Gabe Wilson: Yep. Dry run prints the plan + resolved inputs. Also:
`rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --dry-run --format=json > /tmp/plan.json`
Then grep `region`, `subnet_ids`, `image_version`.

Victor Alvarez: + please ensure the plan includes the DNS resolver IP we expect. If it’s pulling prod resolver it’ll pass smoke tests but break later.

Nina Petrova: Imaging step: which golden image are we using? I want it pinned in the plan output.

Harish Reddy: Current staging default in tfvars is `gpu_node_image=ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-18.1`. Is that the intended one?

Vanessa Ortiz: For this run we should use `ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-22.2` (includes the driver pin + kernel params from the checklist). @Gabe can you override at run trigger time?

Gabe Wilson: Yep, we can pass overrides:
`rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --set image_version=ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-22.2`
(and it’s captured in the audit log + run record)

Aisha Bello: Please do that. Otherwise our metrics baseline is apples/oranges.

DeployBot: deploy finished: `control-plane-staging` (build: 2025.02.26-rc3)

Gabe Wilson: Flag enable now.
Command:
`rwctl admin flags set --env=staging provision_to_ready_pipeline_v2 true`
Output: ok

Gabe Wilson: Verification:
`rwctl admin flags get --env=staging | grep provision_to_ready`
`provision_to_ready_pipeline_v2 = true`

Harish Reddy: 👍 can we start dry run now?

Vanessa Ortiz: go for it. please paste the dry-run summary + any scary diffs.

Gabe Wilson: Dry run launched.
`rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --dry-run --set image_version=ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-22.2`
Summary:
- region: us-west-2
- sku: l40s
- subnet_ids: subnet-0d3… subnet-09a…
- security_groups: sg-0c1…
- image_version: ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-22.2
- helm_chart: runtime-serve@1.18.7
- stages: Provisioning -> Imaging -> Bootstrapping -> Validating
No policy violations.

Victor Alvarez: subnet ids match staging VPC. 👍

Nina Petrova: helm chart 1.18.7 is the pinned one we want for this sprint. good.

Vanessa Ortiz: Proceed with real run.

Gabe Wilson: Real run triggered.
`rwctl provision run --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a --reason "staging pilot" --set image_version=ri-gpu-golden-2025-02-22.2`
Run ID: `prun_stg_01HPR6Q1Z3D9`
Correlation ID: `prov-9f4c1d7c2a`

Fleet Provisioner Bot: Provisioning started for pool `ded-stg-internal-a` (run `prun_stg_01HPR6Q1Z3D9`). Stage: Provisioning. Correlation: `prov-9f4c1d7c2a`. Dashboard: https://grafana.stg.redwood.ai/d/ded-ttready?var-run_id=prun_stg_01HPR6Q1Z3D9

Harish Reddy: Watching terraform apply from my end too. If we hit IAM/quota errors I’ll grab logs.

Rafael Mendes: I’m watching “stuck stage” panel in staging. Threshold set to warn at 2x budget, no paging.

Aisha Bello: Captured correlation ID in my notes. Will screenshot stage timings once we hit Validating.

Kira Thompson: noted. also pasting expected “Ready handoff” verification command here (please confirm):
- `rwctl pools get --env=staging --pool=ded-stg-internal-a | grep readiness_state`
Expect: `readiness_state=Ready`
Then verify routing:
- `rwctl routing pools --env=staging --region=us-west-2 | grep ded-stg-internal-a`
Expect it appears only AFTER Ready.

Gabe Wilson: ^ yep, that’s correct. If it shows up during Validating, we should treat as a bug (we had that race condition once).

Victor Alvarez: When we hit Validating, I’ll run the DNS/TLS checks from inside the cluster and paste results.

Connor O'Brien: reminder: if anything feels off, pause first, debug second. `rwctl provision pause --env=staging --run-id prun_stg_01HPR6Q1Z3D9`

Vanessa Ortiz: thanks all. keep updates in-thread w/ stage transitions + any manual interventions. goal is to turn this into the final runbook section.
